full_name: Rachel Morello-Frosch | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Radcliffe-Salata Climate Justice Fellow UC Berkeley
bio: Trained in environmental health science and epidemiology, Rachel Morello-Frosch is a renowned expert on structural determinants of environmental health inequities and a leader in applying community-engaged science to address environmental justice questions in the context of climate change and the effects of toxic chemicals on human health. At Radcliffe, she will develop solutions- and community-driven scientific projects to better elucidate the health and equity benefits of climate change policies and create accessible online data visualization tools for diverse audiences seeking to advance sustainability and environmental justice goals in environmental policy.
